        rejectsShortTripsAlmostEverywhere (mu 1) (rho 1)) ∧
      ∀ rho : Fin 2 → TripPolicy, dynamicMeasurableOptimal R rho →
        rejectsLongTripsFiniteOrInfiniteCutoffAlmostEverywhere (mu 0) (rho 0) ∧
          rejectsShortTripsAlmostEverywhere (mu 1) (rho 1) :=
